description: Labelled audio examples for RelayGuard evaluation. Ground truth from the case history; app verdicts recorded at the labelled version.

cases.note: The v6 failure that motivated corpus calibration. A audio not recoverable (pre-v2 export did not embed audio); analysis JSON preserved at relayguard-analysis-2026-08-26T13-58-08.json.

app_result_at_v7.verdict: UNCERTAIN (quality gate) with voice panel 5/5 DIFFERENT

cases.note: User field recordings. Ground truth encoded in filenames. Baseline expectations: handset noise bed ~-67 dB under speech vs speakerphone ~-8.5 dB; spectral smear ~0.0034 (handset) vs ~0.1469 (speakerphone); duty cue flips sign in noise and must be read with the noise measurement.

8 male speakers x 2 utterances + user_voice.wav; manifest at docs/test-fixtures/manifest.json. Same-speaker pairs should reach SAME or NO_CONSENSUS; all cross pairs (incl. user vs 32 VoxForge males) should reach DIFFERENT or NO_CONSENSUS, never SAME. Known conservative boundary: GusSCalabrese pair yields DIFFERENT (creaky tail, F0 105->86 Hz) — matches held-out 1/180 false-different rate.
